description.value: Gabriella's Restaurant is an Italian-inspired dining destination in downtown Rossland, helmed by Chef Gabriella Pelli Lapointe, who brought her Southern Italian culinary roots to the Kootenays after opening her first restaurant in Fernie in 1995. The establishment spans three distinct venues: a family-friendly casual fine-dining room, an adults-only Uptown Lounge serving appetizers and burgers, and Caffè Gabriella offering specialty coffees, housemade baking, and full breakfasts. The family-run business has earned a strong regional reputation for fresh ingredients, traditional Italian technique, and a warm, welcoming atmosphere.
